subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: The Spider as Weaver
description: One-minute skill: The Spider as Weaver.

hook.text: Arachne challenged Athena to a weaving contest—and won. The goddess turned her into a spider in rage.

buildup.text: Spiders weave intricate webs from their own bodies. Cultures saw in them the act of creation itself.

discovery.text: In Navajo tradition, Spider Woman taught humans to weave. The spider's web is a gift, not a trap.

twist.text: The web is both a creation and a snare. Spiders build beauty that kills. Art and danger in the same thread.

climax.text: The spider is the ultimate creator-trickster: silent, patient, and building worlds from its own substance.

punchline.text: She spins worlds from her own body.

quiz.question: Why did Athena turn Arachne into a spider?
options: Arachne beat Athena in a weaving contest
